title: Baseband File Writer
text: Write baseband signals to file, 1 input, {Metadata (structure or object)} sets Data describing baseband signal empty structure; {Baseband file name} sets the name of baseband file, {Center frequency (Hz)} sets the center frequency of baseband, {Number of latest samples to write} sets the number of samples and {Simulate using} selects simulation mode. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Baseband file name
params.values: Name of baseband file to write untitled.bb (default) | character vector

params.name: Center frequency (Hz)
params.values: Center frequency of baseband signal 1e8 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Metadata (structure or object)
params.values: Data describing baseband signal empty structure ( struct() ) (default) | structure | object

params.name: Number of latest samples to write
params.values: Number of samples to write inf (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Select simulation mode Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
